responsibility: Declares the derive expander for builtin #[derive(Copy)]. It defines DeriveCopy as a DeriveVisitor specialization that turns supported Rust item kinds into a synthesized Copy marker-trait impl, exposing the go entry point, the helper that creates the impl block, and the type-shape visit hooks used by the expansion pass.
same_name_distinction: Declares the DeriveCopy specialization and its copy_impl helper plus shape-specific visit hooks. Unlike the paired implementation file, it exposes the Copy derive expander’s interface, not the code that builds the synthesized marker-trait impls.
